exhibit_title: Amendment No. 3 to Google Cloud Platform Addendum
note: avenant n° 3 à l'addendum Google Cloud Platform : capacité de calcul N2 à la demande ajoutée, montants caviardés
quote: This Amendment ("Amendment") is between Google LLC ("Google") and the Customer in the signature block below ("Customer") and amends the Google Cloud Platform License Agreement previously entered into by the parties with an effective date on December 15, 2016 (as amended, the "Agreement"). Such Agreement includes the Google Cloud Platform Addendum entered into by the parties with an effective date on February 13, 2020 (as amended, the "Addendum").
